title: Finite projective principal localizations give a finite locally free associated sheaf on an open
statement: Let A be a commutative ring and U an open of Spec A [def-pc-scheme]. Let M be an A-module. Suppose that for every f in A with D(f) contained in U, M_f is a finite projective A_f-module. Then the restriction to U of the associated sheaf tilde M is finite locally free [def-sc-finite-locally-free-sheaf]. No finite presentation or finiteness of M on all of Spec A is assumed.

source.place: Tag 00NX, (2) implies (7); used sheaf-locally in perfect.tex Tag 08EG

proof.text: Principal opens D(f) contained in U form a basis and cover U. For each such f the restriction of tilde M to Spec A_f identifies with the associated sheaf of M_f by the localization description of associated sheaves.

source.place: Tag 01HV, associated modules on affine schemes, localization on standard opens

proof.text: By hypothesis M_f is finite projective. Apply lem-weil-pbc-finite-projective-standard-free-cover over A_f. Its finite standard cover has finite free iterated localizations of M. Associated sheaf commutes with these localizations and sends finite free modules to finite free sheaves. The composite opens cover U, so the definition of finite local freeness gives the conclusion. Empty U uses an empty cover and zero modules have rank zero.

theorem finiteLocallyFree_restrict_tilde_of_principalOpen_projective
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (U : (Spec (.of A)).Opens) (M : ModuleCat.{u} A)
    (h : ∀ f : A, PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f ≤ U →
      Module.Finite (Localization.Away f) (LocalizedModule.Away f M) ∧
        Module.Projective (Localization.Away f) (LocalizedModule.Away f M)) :
    SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFree.{u, u, u}
      (((@id (ModuleCat.{u} A ⥤
          SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace))
          (tilde.functor (.of A))) ⋙
        SheafOfModules.overFunctor (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace) U ⋙
        Equivalence.functor
          (C := SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace).over U))
          (D := SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace))
          (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U)).obj M)
